shot.title: Visual communication personalization loop
shot.summary: The user wants Leaven to learn how to communicate visually: create a picture or diagram for a bounded shot, compare it to the source moment, and store short natural-language feedback with enough conversation context to optimize future visual communication.
known_blockers: Live Syke state on darins-macbook-pro is unverified because SSH hung, likely on 1Password-backed auth.

leaven_projection.evidence_shape_guess: mixed free-text feedback plus optional pairwise preference
leaven_projection.first_persistence_bias: local durable file first, then promote
